task.title: Relics: guidance points at `relic update --help` for the other edits
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M78). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

The agent guidance teaches only the body save. Changing a title, a property or a field, and adding, moving, removing, restoring and exporting, appear in neither the guidelines nor the skill. `workbook relic update --help` covers them.

## Wanted

Add one line to the guidelines and the skill that points at `workbook relic update --help` for the other edits.

## Done when

- Both texts carry the line, and the guidance tests pass.
